observed.valid_config: Configured root resolved and registered; input remained byte-for-byte unchanged.
observed.missing_root_config: Previous root was cleared rather than falling back to HOME.
observed.marker_config_failure: Missing marker folder -> NotFound; corrupt marker ID -> InvalidRequest

observed.valid_records: Current success, current failure, and legacy success IDs loaded.
observed.ignored_records: Blank/path/whitespace-corrupt IDs did not create state.
observed.retryability: Transient failures remained retryable; permanent failures remained retained.
observed.marker_order: Load and validation preceded any marker state publication.

observed.planning: Whole-root dedupe reduced three synthetic entries to one new item despite an existing file in another playlist.
marker_rules: validated output wrote valid-id success marker
invalid and missing output did not write success markers
cancel-id did not write success marker
observed.retry: transient-id succeeded on a subsequent local callback; retained permanent-id was not retried.
observed.terminal: cancelled after cancel-id; sequential processing stopped.

observed.promotion_command: Validated synthetic staged bytes promoted atomically into a configured playlist destination.
observed.scan_order: After promotion, ScanLibrary completed and GetLibrary returned playlist-a / Track.
observed.boundary: This is direct AppState command dispatch, not evidence from a launched Tauri bridge or a provider download.

warnings_and_limitations: Every successful Rust run emitted the same three pre-existing warnings: unused mut in migration/first_run.rs, unused error in download/sync.rs, and an unused macOS Keychain symbol.
No provider extraction, yt-dlp, network, credentials, Keychain, audio bytes, real HOME, or real music library was used.
The current source exposes PromoteAudioOutput in the Rust Command enum and AppState dispatch; the evidence-plan statement that the command variant is absent is stale and was not repeated.
No launched Tauri process, UI event bridge, real direct download, or provider response was exercised.
The controlled promotion test proves validated local promotion and subsequent scan visibility only; it does not prove end-to-end download/provider behavior.

overall_verdict.rationale: All requested local persistence, marker, sync, retry, error, and promotion seam tests passed, but launched Tauri/UI bridge and provider/download boundaries remain unexercised.
